relevant_prelims_pyqs.markdown_formatted:
**Q2 (2024)**: Under which of the following Articles of the Constitution of India has the Supreme Court of India placed the Right to Privacy? [2024]
- (a) Article 15
- (b) Article 16
- (c) Article 19
- (d) Article 21

relevant_prelims_pyqs.question_text: Right to Privacy is protected as an intrinsic part of Right to Life and Personal Liberty. Which of the following in the Constitution of India correctly and appropriately imply the above statement? [2018]

options.a: Article 14 and the provisions under the 42nd Amendment to the Constitution
options.b: Article 17 and the Directive Principles of State Policy in Part IV
options.c: Article 21 and the freedoms guaranteed in Part III
options.d: Article 24 and the provisions under the 44th Amendment to the Constitution

relevant_prelims_pyqs.source_pdf: X-Factor Prelims- Indian Polity for Pre'2027.pdf
relevant_prelims_pyqs.markdown_formatted:
**Q11 (2018)**: Right to Privacy is protected as an intrinsic part of Right to Life and Personal Liberty. Which of the following in the Constitution of India correctly and appropriately imply the above statement? [2018]
- (a) Article 14 and the provisions under the 42nd Amendment to the Constitution
- (b) Article 17 and the Directive Principles of State Policy in Part IV
- (c) Article 21 and the freedoms guaranteed in Part III

It can derive benefits from the Prime Minister's 15-Point Programme. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

It can derive benefits from the Prime Minister's 15-Point Programme. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

- (b) 2 and 3 only
